title: Maintenance (Assurance of Payment) Law, 5732-1972
source_id: ס״ח תשל״ב, 87 (corrigendum 127); Knesset legislation database lawitemid 2000355; Wikisource page חוק המזונות (הבטחת תשלום)
verified_how: Fetched the Hebrew Wikisource page raw wikitext on 2026-10-08 (revision 2883910, last edited 2024-09-23T13:43:24Z). The page heading prints the title as חוק המזונות (הבטחת תשלום), תשל״ב–1972 and the metadata box carries Knesset legislation number 2000355. In-force status was not separately checked against the Knesset database; Wikisource's maintained text states no repeal.
notes: The Law under which the National Insurance Institute pays maintenance (alimony) where a court order is unpaid; named by NII s 68(c) triggers (BACKLOG IL-33).
text_format: MediaWiki source of the consolidated Hebrew text, with its citation apparatus (the ח:תיבה templates carry the Sefer HaChukim references and Knesset PDF links; ח:סעיף templates open each section)
text_caveat: Unofficial consolidation. Israel publishes no free official consolidated text; the official version is the original publication in Reshumot plus every amending Act. The text is the law as maintained on Hebrew Wikisource at retrieval (page revision 2883910, last edited 2024-09-23T13:43:24Z), not a historical vintage.
